copy.headline:
A garden design
grounded in
horticulture.
copy.sub: Dimension Gardenscape has offered “a qualified horticultural perspective” on landscape projects since Trevor Fuller established the business in 2007. Design, construction and plant knowledge sit in the one team — members of the Australian Institute of Horticulture, the Master Builders Association ACT and The Landscape Association.
copy.statementBody: Most landscaping quotes come from a construction crew working out what to plant afterwards. Dimension Gardenscape's own team trained in horticulture before construction — Trevor started as an apprentice greenkeeper, moved into irrigation and horticulture, then design and build. The team's ongoing horticultural education is part of how every project is run, not an afterthought.
copy.servicesIntro: Landscape design, construction, decks and pergolas, retaining walls, garden art and wicking beds — plus small, balcony and vertical-wall garden design. One team from the first sketch to the last plant.
copy.apertureLine: Design, construction and horticulture — one team, one call.
copy.workHeadline:
Canberra and Queanbeyan
gardens, start to finish.
copy.workIntro: Ainslie, a curved-deck Ngunnawal build, a Deakin front garden, a Harrison courtyard and a minimalist rear-garden rebuild — real jobs, photographed as finished.
copy.processIntro: The design and quoting stage runs two weeks to a month depending on complexity. You see the concept plan before anything is booked in.
copy.reviewsIntro: Real reviews from their Google profile — 54 of them. Clients name Trevor and the crew directly.
copy.recognitionIntro: Members of the Australian Institute of Horticulture, the Master Builders Association ACT and The Landscape Association — not just a review page.
copy.areasIntro: Based in Queanbeyan. Servicing North and South Canberra, the ACT, Queanbeyan, Googong, Jerrabomberra, Barton, Woden, Bungendore, Belconnen and Gungahlin.
copy.enquireIntro: Every garden is different — the more you can tell us about the space and what you want from it, the more useful the first conversation will be.

He ran a family landscape design and construction business on weekends from around the mid-1990s, and established Dimension Gardenscape in its present form in 2007.

process.detail: We discuss your ideas, your lifestyle and use for the garden, and the style you prefer. Our designer checks site constraints and opportunities, and talks through your budget.
A sketch plan showing the main elements of the design, followed by a second meeting for your feedback on the layout, plant species and materials.
The final concept plan, showing all plants and hardscape details, with any staging discussed and a quote prepared.

Our team builds it — site prep, structural work, paving, then topsoil, planting, turf, irrigation and mulch. A booking fee secures your place in the schedule; a materials deposit is due four weeks before construction starts, with weekly progress payments during the build.

reviews.name: Rachel Heffernan
reviews.text: Great experience overall! Trevor was lovely to speak to and dealt with any issues we had. Everything was done as we expected it to be. Thank you. If we need anymore landscaping, we know who to contact.

reviews.text: Dimension Gardenscape installed a Japanese garden at the front of our house. They did a great job, and had a friendly and competent team. The garden plan required the installation of some very large rocks, and the entire process took 3 days. It all went like clockwork, and we were delighted with the result.

faq.q: Can I see examples of your work?
faq.a: Yes. Once we have a rough idea of the garden design you're after, we can put you in touch with previous clients with similar projects, or you can view our work on this page.
Every garden is different, with many different components and costings. Call us on 02 6297 9040 for a free quote.

faq.q: How long will my project take?
faq.a: Design and quoting typically runs two weeks to a month, depending on the complexity of the project — a bespoke water feature or engineered retaining wall needs a more detailed design and quote than a small garden refresh. Construction time depends on the size and scope of the job, plus material availability and weather.

Our own team of experienced, qualified landscapers and designers — including qualified carpentry for decks and pergolas. Where a project needs another trade, we coordinate with a solid network of specialists such as electricians and plumbers.

faq.q: Are you on site, or in an office somewhere?
faq.a: In Trevor's words: “As Chief Landscaper, I spend most of my time on site, however if I am needed elsewhere on the day I am easily contactable anytime.”

faq.q: Can I do some of the work myself to save money?
faq.a: Yes — a lot of our quotations can be changed to supply-only, letting you take on parts of the work yourself. Many clients choose to handle the planting and mulching.

A booking fee secures your place in our schedule, then a materials deposit is due four weeks before construction starts so we can order materials ahead of time. Progress payments are charged weekly during construction, followed by a finalised bill. We accept direct deposit, cash, cheque and online card payment.
